X Post Cleaner · Free
Speed
100–350 actions a day (you pick), shared by deleting and unliking.
Why not faster?
X doesn't publish a browser limit, but accounts that delete too fast get rate-limited, locked or asked to verify. 100–350 a day stays under that.
{paceSafetyNote}
Cost
$0. We never charge you or take a cut.
Setup
Nothing to set up beyond picking your rules.
If something goes wrong
If X slows things down, it waits and continues on its own. A lock or verification check stops the run until you clear it. Nothing is deleted twice.
X Post Cleaner · Fast (your key)
Speed
About 4,000 a day. Spend so far and your stop-at limit, shown live.
Limit
X's published limit is 50 per 15 minutes (about 4,800/day). We stay a little under it.
Cost
X charges your developer key about $0.01 per delete, billed by X to you. We never charge you or take a cut.
Setup
Your own X developer key.
Deletes
Posts, replies and quote posts. Reposts and Remove my likes run in the Free lane for now: X's API needs each original post's id, which the archive doesn't include, and API unliking isn't confirmed yet.
If something goes wrong
If X slows things down, it waits and continues. A lock or warning stops the run until you clear it. At your stop-at limit, or if your X credits run out, it stops; top up or raise the limit and it continues where it left off, with nothing deleted twice.
Other X/Twitter deleting apps and sites
Speed
Paid official-API apps vary; cheap plans often cap around 500 deletes a month. Free browser tools are often limited to a few hundred deletes at a time.
Limit
Free browser tools hit rate limits about every couple hundred deletes and need cooldowns.
Cost
Paid apps typically charge roughly $8–11 a month, or about $99 lifetime, and use X's official API. Free browser tools don't pay X's per-delete fee.
Setup
Paid apps usually have you sign in and pick a plan. Some jobs stall unless you upload an archive. Browser tools run in your browser.
If something goes wrong
Some users report runs freezing or stopping partway, so they have to restart or re-upload.
